field_principles.preconditions_checked: Exact source gates stop reduction when authority is missing.
field_principles.random_seed: The fixed seed records deterministic transform ordering.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: The checksum detects evidence drift except wall time.

field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hashes bind the raw fixture and discrepancy evidence.
field_principles.spec_refs: Requirement anchors connect the artifact to executable tests.
field_principles.status: Status separates a complete audit from a blocked precondition.
field_principles.typed_program_authority_ready_score: This gate requires parity and unique identities.
